thread:
Leah M.: Quick flag — during yesterday's peak window ~8% of inbound leads landed in HubSpot but never got a Salesforce owner within 30s. Seeing a spike in webhook 5xx retries and a couple of claim backlog spikes. Sharing sample logs and a quick mitigation plan.
Javier R.: Ugh. Is this the same spike we saw in the morning batch? Any correlation with enrichment latency?
Leah M.: Looks correlated. Enrichment service had an intermittent TTL extension (avg extra 1.2s) but the real issue is claim flow: when enrichment delays, our round-robin bucket sometimes stalls and retries stack up. Sample HS webhook body (redacted):
```json
{"contact":{"email":"xxx@yyy.com","lead_score":78},"properties":{"utm_source":"web","geo":"EMEA"}}
```
Priya S.: Can we short-circuit assignment for high-prop leads? e.g., if lead_score >= 70 -> immediate sticky assign to SDR pool, async enrichment afterwards.
Tom B.: Technically doable. Two quick options:
1) Add a pre-routing rule in HubSpot that writes a "fast_assign" flag and bypasses enrichment call for those leads (low risk).
2) Increase claim worker concurrency + add jitter to round-robin to reduce contention (more infra effort).
lead-processor-bot: noticed 412 retries on /assign endpoint between 09:10-09:18 UTC. Avg retry delay 350ms.
Leah M.: I like option 1 as a fast mitigation. We can combine with option 2 as a medium-term fix. Priya, do we have a reliable property to use for "fast_assign"?
Priya S.: Yes — we can use the machine_score property (generated by inbound model). It's already populated sync in ~95% of cases. We should also guard for false positives by limiting to leads with country in supported list.
Javier R.: Heads up: sales side wants to avoid any change that increases false assignments. Can we test on 5% traffic first and track SLA metrics? If good, roll to 100%.
Tom B.: We'll need a small feature flag in routing service and a canary toggle in HubSpot workflow. I can spin a short-lived feature flag by EOD and add metric emission for two new gauges: assign_latency and assign_fail_rate.
Leah M.: Proposed plan:
- Today: create HubSpot workflow that sets `fast_assign` for machine_score>=70 AND geo in {US,CA,EMEA} (Priya)
- Today: Tom to add flag + metric hooks, canary to 5% traffic (Tom)
- Tomorrow: run 24h canary, compare assign_latency and coverage vs baseline (Leah/Javier)
- If assign_fail_rate <= baseline + 1% and assign_latency improved -> rollforward to 100% and schedule worker concurrency tune (Priya/Tom)
Javier R.: Sounds good. Also request a short playbook note for triage if the enrichment queue grows — i.e., move fast_assign leads to a separate async enrichment route so we don't block main pipeline.
Leah M.: Added to playbook draft. I'll post link when done. Quick ask: Tom, can you add an alert if assign_fail_rate spikes above 2% in the canary window?
Tom B.: Yep. I'll add a PagerDuty alert and a Grafana panel. Setting threshold at 2% for now.
Priya S.: I'll backstop with an internal Slack pulse every 60m during the canary showing percent-assigned-within-30s.
Leah M.: Great — thanks team. If all goes well we'll aim to ship the HubSpot workflow + flag before tomorrow morning's peak. Will post the playbook link and test plan here once created. :thumbsup:
